requirements.condition: a client offers multiple potential PSKs
requirements.required_behavior: compute an Early Secret for each potential PSK

requirements.quote:
There are multiple potential Early Secret values, depending on which
   PSK the server ultimately selects.  The client will need to compute
   one for each potential PSK; if no PSK is selected, it will then need
   to compute the Early Secret corresponding to the zero PSK.
requirements.condition: the server selects no offered PSK
requirements.required_behavior: compute the Early Secret corresponding to the zero PSK
requirements.why_checkable: The no-selection branch has a deterministic fallback derivation.

requirements.quote:
Once all the values which are to be derived from a given secret have
   been computed, that secret SHOULD be erased.
requirements.condition: all values to be derived from a given secret have been computed
requirements.why_checkable: Secret lifetime can be inspected after the final dependent derivation.
